The '''Wilderness God Wars Dungeon''' is a multi-combat area located within a cave east of [[The Forgotten Cemetery]] at level 28 [[Wilderness]]. It contains monsters from the main [[God Wars Dungeon]]. The cave was opened to the monsters when an underground tremor caused a deep fissure to open up, which caused the creatures to climb through the fissure and populate the cave.{{CiteNews|url=https://secure.runescape.com/m=news/rejuvenating-the-wilderness-more-risk-more-reward?oldschool=1|title=Rejuvenating the Wilderness: More risk, more reward|newsdate=13 March 2014|quote=The same underground tremor has caused a deep fissure to open up in a cave near the Forgotten Cemetery. Creatures from the God Wars Dungeon have climbed through this fissure and now populate the cave.}} Like the main God Wars Dungeon, all monsters in the dungeon are [[aggressive]] to any player unless they have equipped at least one [[god item|item]] that is devoted to their god. The entire area counts as the Wilderness. Players will be able to attack you here.

==Transportation==
As the dungeon is located within the Wilderness, players must go through the Wilderness to get to the Wilderness God Wars Dungeon. Methods of getting to the dungeon include:

*Using the [[Wilderness Obelisk]]. The closest obelisk is the level 27 obelisk, located slightly south-east of the entrance. The Wilderness Obelisk system can be quickly accessed from one's [[Obelisk (Construction)|player-owned house]] (80 Construction required), or by teleporting to the [[Corporeal Beast]]'s cave and running south-east to the level 19 obelisk. Completion of the hard tier of the [[Wilderness diary]] allows the player to select the destination obelisk.
*Casting the [[Cemetery Teleport]] spell on the [[Arceuus spellbook]] or the corresponding [[Cemetery teleport (tablet)|tablet]] to [[The Forgotten Cemetery]] and running east.
*Casting the [[Dareeyak Teleport]] spell on the [[Ancient spellbook]] or breaking a [[Dareeyak teleport|Dareeyak teleport tablet]] to the [[Ruins (west)|ruins]] at level 23 Wilderness. Both require completion of [[Desert Treasure I]] to use.
*Using a [[burning amulet]] teleport to the [[Bandit Camp (Wilderness)|Bandit Camp]] and running west then north.
*Using the [[agility shortcut]] from [[Trollheim]] puts you much closer than running directly from [[Edgeville]], but requires 64 [[Agility]].
*Running directly from the [[Ferox Enclave]]. 
*Running directly to the dungeon from [[Edgeville]].
*Using a [[Revenant cave teleport]] and running west.

==God-related protection==
{{Main|God Wars Dungeon#God-related protection}}

==Features==
The dungeon has a small, empty cavern that splits apart into two different paths: the north-west one will lead to [[Boulder (Wilderness God Wars Dungeon)|a large boulder]] which can be moved with 60 [[Strength]], or the south-east which passes through [[Jutting wall (Wilderness God Wars Dungeon)|a jutting wall]] which requires 60 [[Agility]]. [[Temporary skill boost]]s can be used to bypass the requirements. A small crevice is behind the obstacle, which can be used to enter the main dungeon. The Agility path drops players off near Bandos' encampment, while the Strength path drops players off near Armadyl's encampment. 

This empty cavern is a single-way combat zone. The large cavern in which the followers fight is a multi-way combat zone. 

The Wilderness God Wars Dungeon works the same way as the main dungeon - players can wear the respective [[god item|god equipment]] to make monsters aligned to their god unaggressive, along with the typical aggressive monsters that initiate combat with other monsters. However, due to the layout of the faction "camps" in the dungeon, the fighting only usually takes place in the centre and southern areas of the dungeon.

The main attraction of the dungeon is the [[ecumenical key]], which all monsters in the dungeon can drop. Players can have up to 3, 4, or 5 of these keys in their bank, with the maximum depending on [[Wilderness Diary]] tier completion. The drop rate is increased as higher tiers of the [[Combat Achievements]] are reached. The keys allow players to skip the kill count needed to enter the general's room in the regular [[God Wars Dungeon]]. They may also be sold to the [[Lesser Fanatic]] for 61,500 coins with completion of the Hard Wilderness Diary. The aviansie in this dungeon also drop noted [[adamantite bar]]s. 

The dungeon is also visited by players on slayer assignments, mostly for [[spiritual creature]]s due to being far easier to access and those assigned potential monsters inside by [[Krystilia]].

==Wilderness Diary==
There are 4 tasks of the [[Wilderness Diary]] to be completed in this area:
*Enter the dungeon (medium)
*Kill a [[Bloodveld]] (medium)
*Kill a [[Spiritual warrior]] (hard)
*Slay a [[Spiritual mage]] (elite)

==Trivia==
*The dungeon lacks several followers compared to the main dungeon:
**[[Saradomin priest]]s do not appear in the dungeon.
**Bandosian [[Hobgoblin#Hobgoblin (GWD)|hobgoblins]], [[Jogre#GWD|jogres]], and [[Cyclops (God Wars Dungeon)|cyclopes]] do not appear in the dungeon.
